summary.text: T. Kevan Bartlett is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate from District 8, listed with Kanawha County; the district covers Roane and Clay counties and parts of Kanawha, Putnam, Jackson and Wirt. His legislative page lists him as vice chair of the Judiciary and Pensions committees.

paragraphs.text: Bartlett's page lists his occupation as pastor of Maranatha Baptist Church and gives his birthplace as Chattanooga, Tennessee.
It names his spouse as Linda Bartlett and lists two sons, Thomas K. Bartlett Jr. and Travis K. Bartlett.
Bartlett also serves on the Senate's Education, Health and Human Resources, Interstate Cooperation and Military committees.
